::: {#perfil}

PhD in Mechanical Engineering from PUC-Rio, MSc from UFRJ, and BSc in Physics from UERJ, with an MBA in Data Science from ICMC-USP. He was an applied machine learning specialist at FGV (2023–2025), working with physics-based models (PINNs, Neural ODEs). He is currently a researcher and senior data scientist at Radix.

## Education

- MBA in Data Science, ICMC/USP.
- PhD in Mechanical Engineering, PUC-Rio.
- MSc in Civil Engineering (Computational Geophysics), UFRJ.
- BSc in Physics, UERJ.

## Interests

Scientific machine learning, computational simulation, and predictive models.
